INSERT INTO deals (contact_id, deal_name, stage, probability, assigned_to, client_id, notes) SELECT c.id, '{{ $json.meeting_type }} - ' || c.company || ' (' || c.first_name || ')', 'qualification', 20, '{{ $json.assigned_to }}', {{ $json.client_id || 'c.client_id' }}, '{{ $json.notes }}' FROM contacts c WHERE c.email = '{{ $json.email }}' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deals d WHERE d.contact_id = c.id AND d.stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')) RETURNING *
